footer.tagline: A pause for the soul. Selah is a place to be heard, prayed for, and gently pointed toward something steadying.
footer.disclaimer: Selah is not a substitute for professional counseling, medical care, or emergency services. If you are in crisis, please reach out to a crisis line or emergency services near you.

home.badge: A sacred pause for your soul
home.subtitle: Selah is a calm place to bring your burdens, fear, grief, confusion, or hope and meet gentle guidance, comforting scripture, and prayerful care rooted in the Bible.

companion.title: A Companion Who Listens
companion.desc: Tell Nia what is weighing on you. She responds with empathy and gently offers scripture that fits your moment.

prayer.title: A Real Prayer, From a Real Person
prayer.desc: Submit a prayer request anonymously if you wish. A spiritual leader receives it and prays over it, and you will know when she has.

testimonies.title: Testimonies of Hope
testimonies.desc: Read what happened for others after a prayer was answered. Share your own story when the time is right.

bible.title: Read the Bible
bible.desc: Browse every book and chapter in KJV, WEB, BSB, or Swahili, and search by reference.

home.verseText: Cast all your anxiety on him, because he cares for you.
home.boundaryBody: Nia is here to listen and point you toward scripture she is not a counselor, a therapist, or a crisis service. If you are in immediate danger, please contact emergency services or a crisis line. Nia will always help you find those resources.
